Group.content:
class Group (G : Type) where
  inv : G → G
  one : G
  mul : G → G → G
  mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : G, mul a (mul b c) = mul (mul a b) c
  mul_one   : ∀ a : G, mul a one = a
  one_mul   : ∀ a : G, mul one a = a
  mul_inv_l : ∀ a : G, mul (inv a) a = one
  mul_inv_r : ∀ a : G, mul a (inv a) = one

GroupComm.content:
class GroupComm (G : Type) [Group G] where
  mul_comm : ∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a

mul_rotate'.content:
theorem mul_rotate' (a b c : G) : a * (b * c) = b * (c * a) := by
    rw [GroupComm.mul_comm]
    rw [← Group.mul_assoc]

mul_left_cancel.content:
theorem mul_left_cancel (a b c : G) (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c := by
    have h' : a⁻¹ * (a * b) = a⁻¹ * (a * c) := by rw [h]
    repeat rw [Group.mul_assoc] at h'
    repeat rw [Group.mul_inv_l] at h'
    repeat rw [Group.one_mul] at h'
    exact h'

mul_right_cancel.content:
theorem mul_right_cancel (a b c : G) (h : b * a = c * a) : b = c := by
    have h' : (b * a) * a⁻¹ = (c * a) * a⁻¹ := by rw [h]
    repeat rw [← Group.mul_assoc] at h'
    repeat rw [Group.mul_inv_r] at h'
    repeat rw [Group.mul_one] at h'
    exact h'

inv_inv.content:
theorem inv_inv (a : G) : (a⁻¹)⁻¹ = a := by
    have h : (a⁻¹)⁻¹ * a⁻¹ = a * a⁻¹ := by
      rw [Group.mul_inv_l, Group.mul_inv_r]
    exact mul_right_cancel _ _ _ h

inv_mul.content:
theorem inv_mul (a b : G) : (a * b)⁻¹ = b⁻¹ * a⁻¹ := by
    have h : (a * b)⁻¹ * (a * b) = (b⁻¹ * a⁻¹) * (a * b) := by
      rw [Group.mul_inv_l]
      repeat rw [← Group.mul_assoc]
      rw [Group.mul_assoc (a⁻¹) a b]
      rw [Group.mul_inv_l]
      rw [Group.one_mul]
      rw [Group.mul_inv_l]
    exact mul_right_cancel _ _ _ h

inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one.content:
theorem inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one (a b : G) (h : a * b = one) : b = a⁻¹ := by
    have h' : a⁻¹ * (a * b) = a⁻¹ * one := by rw [h]
    rw [Group.mul_assoc, Group.mul_inv_l, Group.one_mul, Group.mul_one] at h'
    exact h'

Act.content:
class Act (G : Type) (X : Type) [Group G] where
  act : G → X → X
  act_one : ∀ x : X, act one x = x
  act_mul : ∀ g h : G, ∀ x : X, act (g * h) x = act g (act h x)

G.content: variable {G : Type} {X : Type} [Group G] [Act G X]

X.content: variable {G : Type} {X : Type} [Group G] [Act G X]

act_inv.content:
theorem act_inv (g : G) (x : X) : g⁻¹ • (g • x) = x := by
    have h : (g⁻¹ * g) • x = x := by
      rw [Group.mul_inv_l]
      apply Act.act_one
    rw [Act.act_mul] at h
    exact h

act_inv_r.content:
theorem act_inv_r (g : G) (x : X) : g • (g⁻¹ • x) = x := by
    have h : (g * g⁻¹) • x = x := by
      rw [Group.mul_inv_r]
      apply Act.act_one
    rw [Act.act_mul] at h
    exact h

orbit.content:
def orbit {G : Type} {X : Type} [Group G] [Act G X] (x : X) : X → Prop :=
    fun y => ∃ g : G, g • x = y

stabilizer.content: def stabilizer (x : X) : G → Prop := fun g => g • x = x

orbit_refl.content:
theorem orbit_refl
    (x : X) : orbit (G:=G) x x := by
    exists one
    exact Act.act_one x

orbit_sym.content:
theorem orbit_sym (x y : X) (h : orbit (G:=G) x y) : orbit (G:=G) y x := by
    rcases h with ⟨g, hg⟩
    exists g⁻¹
    rw [← hg, ← Act.act_mul, Group.mul_inv_l, Act.act_one]

orbit_trans.content:
theorem orbit_trans (x y z : X) (h1 : orbit (G:=G) x y) (h2 : orbit (G:=G) y z) : orbit (G:=G) x z := by
    rcases h1 with ⟨g1, hg1⟩
    rcases h2 with ⟨g2, hg2⟩
    exists (g2 * g1)
    rw [Act.act_mul, hg1, hg2]

orbit_partition.content:
theorem orbit_partition (x y : X) (hxy : orbit (G:=G) x y) (z : X) :
      orbit (G:=G) x z ↔ orbit (G:=G) y z := by
    constructor
    · intro hz
      rcases hxy with ⟨g1, hg1⟩
      rcases hz with ⟨g2, hg2⟩
      exists (g2 * g1⁻¹)
      rw [Act.act_mul, ← hg1]
      repeat rw [← Act.act_mul]
      rw [← Group.mul_assoc, Group.mul_inv_l, Group.mul_one]
      exact hg2
    · intro hz
      rcases hxy with ⟨g1, hg1⟩
      rcases hz with ⟨g2, hg2⟩
      exists (g2 * g1)
      rw [Act.act_mul, hg1, hg2]

stabilizer_mul.content:
theorem stabilizer_mul (x : X) (g h : G)
    (hg : stabilizer x g) (hh : stabilizer x h) : stabilizer x (g * h) := by
    unfold stabilizer at *
    rw [Act.act_mul, hh, hg]

stabilizer_inv.content:
theorem stabilizer_inv (x : X) (g : G) (hg : stabilizer x g) : stabilizer x g⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [stabilizer] at *
    calc
      g⁻¹ • x = g⁻¹ • (g • x) := by rw [hg]
      _ = (g⁻¹ * g) • x := by rw [Act.act_mul]
      _ = x := by rw [mul_inv_l, Act.act_one]

stabilizer_one.content:
theorem stabilizer_one (x : X) : stabilizer (G:=G) x one := by
    unfold stabilizer
    apply Act.act_one

stabilizer_conjugate.content:
theorem stabilizer_conjugate (x : X) (g h : G)
    (hh : stabilizer x h) : stabilizer (g • x) (g * h * g⁻¹) := by
    unfold stabilizer at *
    rw [← Act.act_mul, ← Group.mul_assoc, Group.mul_inv_l, Group.mul_one, Act.act_mul, hh]

stabilizer_conjugate_orbit.content:
theorem stabilizer_conjugate_orbit (x y : X) (g : G) (hxy : g • x = y) (h : G) :
      stabilizer y h ↔ stabilizer x (g⁻¹ * h * g) := by
    unfold stabilizer
    constructor
    · intro hy
      rw [<- hxy] at hy
      have hy' : g⁻¹ • h • (g • x) = x := by
        rw [hy]
        rw [<- Act.act_mul]
        rw [mul_inv_l, Act.act_one]
      repeat rw [Act.act_mul]
      exact hy'
    · intro hh
      have hh' : g • ((g⁻¹ * h * g) • x) = g • x := by rw [hh]
      rw [hxy] at hh'
      simp [mul_assoc, <- Act.act_mul, mul_inv_r, one_mul] at hh'
      rw [Act.act_mul] at hh'
      rw [hxy] at hh'
      exact hh'

mul_assoc.content: mul_assoc : forall a b c, mul a (mul b  c) = mul (mul a b) c;

mul_one.content: mul_one   : forall a, mul a one = a;

one_mul.content: one_mul   : forall a, mul one a = a;

mul_inv_l.content: mul_inv_l : forall a, mul (inv a) a = one;

mul_inv_r.content: mul_inv_r : forall a, mul a (inv a) = one

mul_comm.content: mul_comm : forall a b, a * b = b * a

Section MulRotate..content:
Section MulRotate.
  Variable G : Type.
  Context `{GroupComm G}.

  Lemma mul_rotate' (a b c : G) : a * (b * c) = b * (c * a).
  Proof.
    rewrite mul_comm.
    rewrite <- mul_assoc.
    trivial.
  Qed.
End MulRotate.

mul_rotate'.content:
Lemma mul_rotate' (a b c : G) : a * (b * c) = b * (c * a).
  Proof.
    rewrite mul_comm.
    rewrite <- mul_assoc.
    trivial.
  Qed.

mul_left_cancel.content:
Lemma mul_left_cancel (a b c : G) :
        a * b = a * c -> b = c.
  Proof.
    intro Ha.
    assert (H' : a^-1 * (a * b) = a^-1 * (a * c)).
    { now rewrite Ha. }

    repeat rewrite mul_assoc in H'.
    repeat rewrite mul_inv_l in H'.
    repeat rewrite one_mul    in H'.
    exact H'.
  Qed.

mul_right_cancel.content:
Lemma mul_right_cancel (a b c : G) :
        b * a = c * a -> b = c.
  Proof.
    intro Ha.
    assert (H' : (b * a) * a^-1 = (c * a) * a^-1).
    { now rewrite Ha. }
    repeat rewrite <- mul_assoc in H'.
    repeat rewrite mul_inv_r in H'.
    repeat rewrite mul_one in H'.
    exact H'.
  Qed.

inv_inv.content:
Lemma inv_inv (a : G) : (a^-1)^-1 = a.
  Proof.
    assert (Ha : (a^-1)^-1 * a^-1 = a * a^-1).
    { now rewrite mul_inv_l, mul_inv_r. }
    apply mul_right_cancel in Ha.
    exact Ha.
  Qed.

inv_mul.content:
Lemma inv_mul (a b : G) :
        (a * b)^-1 = b^-1 * a^-1.
  Proof.
    assert (Ha : (a * b)^-1 * (a * b) = (b^-1 * a^-1) * (a * b)).
    { rewrite mul_inv_l.
      repeat rewrite <- mul_assoc.
      rewrite (mul_assoc (inv a) a b).
      rewrite mul_inv_l.
      rewrite one_mul.
      rewrite mul_inv_l.
      reflexivity.
    }
    apply mul_right_cancel in Ha.
    exact Ha.
  Qed.

inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one.content:
Lemma inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one (a b : G) :
        a * b = 1 -> b = a^-1.
  Proof.
    intro Ha.
    assert (H' : a^-1 * (a * b) = a^-1 * 1).
    { now rewrite Ha. }
    rewrite mul_assoc in H'.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in H'.
    rewrite one_mul  in H'.
    rewrite mul_one  in H'.
    exact H'.
  Qed.

orbit.content:
Definition orbit (x : X) : X -> Prop :=
    fun y => exists g : G, g • x = y.

stabilizer.content:
Definition stabilizer (x : X) : G -> Prop :=
    fun g => g • x = x.

act_inv.content:
Lemma act_inv (g : G) (x : X) :
        g^-1 • (g • x) = x.
  Proof.
    assert (Ha : (g^-1 * g) • x = x).
    { rewrite mul_inv_l.
      apply act_one.
    }
    rewrite act_mul in Ha.
    exact Ha.
  Qed.

act_inv_r.content:
Lemma act_inv_r (g : G) (x : X) :
        g • (g^-1 • x) = x.
  Proof.
    assert (Ha : (g * g^-1) • x = x).
    { rewrite mul_inv_r.
      apply act_one.
    }
    rewrite act_mul in Ha.
    exact Ha.
  Qed.

orbit_refl.content:
Lemma orbit_refl (x : X) : orbit x x.
  Proof.
    exists 1.
    apply act_one.
  Qed.

orbit_sym.content:
Lemma orbit_sym (x y : X) :
        orbit x y -> orbit y x.
  Proof.
    intros [g Hg].
    exists (g^-1).
    rewrite <- Hg.
    rewrite <- act_mul.
    rewrite mul_inv_l.
    apply act_one.
  Qed.

orbit_trans.content:
Lemma orbit_trans (x y z : X) :
        orbit x y -> orbit y z -> orbit x z.
  Proof.
    intros [g1 Hg1] [g2 Hg2].
    exists (g2 * g1).
    rewrite act_mul.
    rewrite Hg1, Hg2.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

orbit_partition.content:
Lemma orbit_partition (x y : X) :
        orbit x y -> forall z, orbit x z <-> orbit y z.
  Proof.
    intros Hxy z.
    split; intros Hz.
    - destruct Hxy as [g1 Hg1].
      destruct Hz as [g2 Hg2].
      exists (g2 * g1^-1).
      rewrite act_mul.
      rewrite <- Hg1.
      repeat rewrite <- act_mul.
      rewrite <- mul_assoc.
      rewrite mul_inv_l.
      rewrite mul_one.
      exact Hg2.
    - destruct Hxy as [g1 Hg1].
      destruct Hz as [g2 Hg2].
      exists (g2 * g1).
      rewrite act_mul.
      rewrite Hg1.
      exact Hg2.
  Qed.

stabilizer_mul.content:
Lemma stabilizer_mul (x : X) (g h : G) :
        stabilizer x g -> stabilizer x h -> stabilizer x (g * h).
  Proof.
    intros Hg Hh.
    unfold stabilizer in *.
    rewrite act_mul.
    rewrite Hh, Hg.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

stabilizer_inv.content:
Lemma stabilizer_inv (x : X) (g : G) :
        stabilizer x g -> stabilizer x (g^-1).
  Proof.
    intro Hg.
    unfold stabilizer in *.
    apply (f_equal (fun y => g^-1 • y)) in Hg.
    rewrite <- act_mul in Hg.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in Hg.
    rewrite act_one in Hg.
    symmetry.
    exact Hg.
  Qed.

stabilizer_one.content:
Lemma stabilizer_one (x : X) :
        stabilizer x 1.
  Proof.
    unfold stabilizer.
    apply act_one.
  Qed.

stabilizer_conjugate.content:
Lemma stabilizer_conjugate (x : X) (g h : G) :
        stabilizer x h -> stabilizer (g • x) (g * h * g^-1).
  Proof.
    intro Hh.
    unfold stabilizer in *.
    rewrite <- act_mul.
    rewrite <- mul_assoc.
    rewrite mul_inv_l.
    rewrite mul_one.
    rewrite act_mul.
    rewrite Hh.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

stabilizer_conjugate_orbit.content:
Lemma stabilizer_conjugate_orbit (x y : X) (g : G) :
        g • x = y ->
        forall h, stabilizer y h <-> stabilizer x (g^-1 * h * g).
  Proof.
    intro Hxy.
    intro h.
    unfold stabilizer.
    split; intro Hh.
    - rewrite <- Hxy in Hh.
      rewrite <- mul_assoc.
      rewrite act_mul.
      rewrite act_mul.
      rewrite Hh.
      rewrite act_inv.
      reflexivity.
    - rewrite <- mul_assoc in Hh.
      repeat rewrite act_mul in Hh.
      apply (f_equal (fun y0 => g • y0)) in Hh.
      repeat rewrite Hxy in Hh.
      rewrite <- act_mul in Hh.
      rewrite mul_inv_r in Hh.
      rewrite <- act_mul in Hh.
      rewrite one_mul in Hh.
      assumption.
  Qed.

coq.statement:
Lemma stabilizer_mul (x : X) (g h : G) :
        stabilizer x g -> stabilizer x h -> stabilizer x (g * h).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros Hg Hh.
    unfold stabilizer in *.
    rewrite act_mul.
    rewrite Hh, Hg.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem stabilizer_inv (x : X) (g : G) (hg : stabilizer x g) : stabilizer x g⁻¹ := by
lean.proof:
dsimp [stabilizer] at *
calc
  g⁻¹ • x = g⁻¹ • (g • x) := by rw [hg]
  _ = (g⁻¹ * g) • x := by rw [Act.act_mul]
  _ = x := by rw [mul_inv_l, Act.act_one]

coq.statement:
Lemma stabilizer_inv (x : X) (g : G) :
        stabilizer x g -> stabilizer x (g^-1).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intro Hg.
    unfold stabilizer in *.
    apply (f_equal (fun y => g^-1 • y)) in Hg.
    rewrite <- act_mul in Hg.
    rewrite mul_inv_l in Hg.
    rewrite act_one in Hg.
    symmetry.
    exact Hg.
  Qed.

lean.statement: theorem stabilizer_one (x : X) : stabilizer (G:=G) x one := by

coq.proof:
Proof.
    unfold stabilizer.
    apply act_one.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem stabilizer_conjugate (x : X) (g h : G)
    (hh : stabilizer x h) : stabilizer (g • x) (g * h * g⁻¹) := by
lean.proof:
unfold stabilizer at *
rw [← Act.act_mul, ← Group.mul_assoc, Group.mul_inv_l, Group.mul_one, Act.act_mul, hh]

coq.statement:
Lemma stabilizer_conjugate (x : X) (g h : G) :
        stabilizer x h -> stabilizer (g • x) (g * h * g^-1).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intro Hh.
    unfold stabilizer in *.
    rewrite <- act_mul.
    rewrite <- mul_assoc.
    rewrite mul_inv_l.
    rewrite mul_one.
    rewrite act_mul.
    rewrite Hh.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem stabilizer_conjugate_orbit (x y : X) (g : G) (hxy : g • x = y) (h : G) :
      stabilizer y h ↔ stabilizer x (g⁻¹ * h * g) := by
lean.proof:
unfold stabilizer
constructor
· intro hy
  rw [<- hxy] at hy
  have hy' : g⁻¹ • h • (g • x) = x := by
    rw [hy]
    rw [<- Act.act_mul]
    rw [mul_inv_l, Act.act_one]
  repeat rw [Act.act_mul]
  exact hy'
· intro hh
  have hh' : g • ((g⁻¹ * h * g) • x) = g • x := by rw [hh]
  rw [hxy] at hh'
  simp [mul_assoc, <- Act.act_mul, mul_inv_r, one_mul] at hh'
  rw [Act.act_mul] at hh'
  rw [hxy] at hh'
  exact hh'

coq.statement:
Lemma stabilizer_conjugate_orbit (x y : X) (g : G) :
        g • x = y ->
        forall h, stabilizer y h <-> stabilizer x (g^-1 * h * g).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intro Hxy.
    intro h.
    unfold stabilizer.
    split; intro Hh.
    - rewrite <- Hxy in Hh.
      rewrite <- mul_assoc.
      rewrite act_mul.
      rewrite act_mul.
      rewrite Hh.
      rewrite act_inv.
      reflexivity.
    - rewrite <- mul_assoc in Hh.
      repeat rewrite act_mul in Hh.
      apply (f_equal (fun y0 => g • y0)) in Hh.
      repeat rewrite Hxy in Hh.
      rewrite <- act_mul in Hh.
      rewrite mul_inv_r in Hh.
      rewrite <- act_mul in Hh.
      rewrite one_mul in Hh.
      assumption.
  Qed.
